responsibility: Defines the ISO termination-status query interface for gm2 programs. It exposes predicates that let library or user code ask whether program termination has begun in any coroutine and whether a HALT has occurred, providing a small public view of runtime shutdown state maintained by the core M2RTS layer.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public specification for TERMINATION: it only declares the standard predicates IsTerminating and HasHalted that clients may import, while the same-stem .mod file provides the runtime-backed implementation of those queries.
